profile.headline: Software Engineer DevOps
profile.summary: System engineer with more than ten years of IT experience. Wide knowledge in Development and Infrastructure. Skills to manage projects  supported with agile methodologies and best practices. High leadership skills and team work. Dynamic, proactive and auto-motivated learner.

positions.title: Web and Middleware Sr Manager Zurich Mexico
positions.description:
• Project Management
• Implement SOA ECM CCM
• Customer Experince
• Create/maintain  web solutions to sell insurance products.
• Propose tranversal solutions  (across Infraestructure, iSeries Develop )
• Review SRS and propose ASD wiht BA and SMEs 
• Explain technical solutions to Business
• Coordinate/guide/review scrum developer teams
